    How to read this map

    Each shape is an existing detached single-family home on a lot smaller than its district's minimum (10,000 sq ft in RS-10, 7,000 sq ft in RS-7 and RL-7). Lot sizes are the assessor's, checked against the mapped outline. Half-duplexes, condominiums and lots with a potential data issue are not shown.

    Year built comes from the assessor record. This map makes no claim about which homes are grandfathered.

    Lots: MassGIS Level 3 assessor parcels, FY2026. Zoning: City of Worcester. Basemap: USGS The National Map (needs internet).
